targets.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM

(SELECT
  p.partition,
  pg_count - bq_count as row_diff,
  table_id,
FROM
  `ridebeam-data.monitoring.row_count` p
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(p.partition)
  )

 PIVOT(MIN(row_diff) FOR table_id IN ( "Trips",
		"TripRoutes",
		"NearbyVehicles",
		"AdyenTransactions",
		"CreditTransactions",
		"Documents",
		"EndTripPhotoAudits",
		"VehicleStatusChanges",
		"VehicleEvents",
		"VehicleSnapshots",
		"VehiclePhoneLocations",
		"Tasks_partition",
		"BatteryEvents_partition",
		"VehicleSummaries_partition",
		"AccountActionLogs_partition",
		"Users_partition",
		"UserRefreshTokens_partition",
		"CreditAccounts_partition",
		"TripInvoices_partition",
		"NonCreditTransactions_partition",
		"HelmetLocks_partition",
		"AdminActionLogs_partition",
		"SafeAcademyQuizResults_partition",
		"UserEvents_partition",
		"VehicleReportedIssues_partition" ))
ORDER BY 1 ASC
